neighbours.label: The one-letter piece ' M' opening a split word or name (M|urchison, M|olyneux, M|alt|itol)
fire: The explorer Mungo Park traced the course of the Niger.

quiet: Sugar-free gum is usually sweetened with Xylitol.
The pianist Ivo Pogorelich divided the critics at Warsaw.

Elena Kagan joined the Supreme Court in 2010.
The heroine Dagny Taggart runs a railroad in the novel.

predictions: Every ' M'-split name reaches 0.3-0.75. Names split on other one-letter pieces (X|ylitol, P|ogorelich, N|ogales, S|agan, K|agan, D|agny) stay under 0.05; two-letter M pieces (Mn|angagwa, Mb|eki) and whole-token M-names are the hard near misses and should stay under 0.2.
notes: Probe: Maltitol 0.713, Murchison 0.683, Mordy 0.575, Macclesfield 0.449, Molyneux 0.347 (all peak ' M'); Burchison 0.009, Kolyneux 0.007 (same tails with B/K pieces), Michael/Microsoft 0.126, Mort|lake 0.192. Card: ' M' x24 of the top 32 peaks. All test words tokenizer-checked: fires split as ' M' + tail, near misses as another single letter, ' Mn'/' Mb', or a whole token.
